entries.00ca5450ae2cc747: A business that supports companies' digital marketing activities. It consists of the SaaS business, which centers on the in-house web analytics tool “SiTest” and performs access analysis and improvement of websites and videos; the online advertising business, which handles planning and proposals, outsourced operation and content production for internet advertising; and the education and reskilling business, which includes the reskilling program “Risunabi” and others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 is ¥1,496 million.

entries.10ae790a51abc2ad: In its core Marketing DX Business, it has built an integrated service structure in which the SaaS business centered on SiTest and the internet advertising business refer projects to each other, while in the Technology Business it is making upfront investments for overseas expansion, such as focusing on system development at its US subsidiary SPAIA, Inc.

It has SPAIA, Inc. in the United States as a consolidated subsidiary, has 106 employees as of December 31, 2025, and is listed on the Growth Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
entries.8abf6eecf73e1dd4: The in-house SiTest is an all-in-one LPO tool with features including heatmap analysis, A/B testing, EFO and AI-equipped reporting, and can provide everything from access analysis to improvement proposals in a consistent manner. In the sports field, it has a distribution platform for sports data, including live pitch-by-pitch reports for professional baseball.

entries.910e1b9f47e76d78: A business that uses AI and data analysis technology. It consists of the DX Development Business, which handles proposal-based contract development and AI-related products such as the AI avatar video production product “AvaTwin,” and the SPAIA Business, which operates the sports data analysis media “SPAIA” and the subscription-based horse racing information service “SPAIA Keiba” and provides sports data. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 is ¥259 million.
